stats.peakSampling: peaks sampled at each momentum refresh of a tracked coin (about every 75 s with 29 tracked) and by the grader every 10 min (oldest 60 open rows per pass) once a coin is no longer tracked: spikes between samples are missed, so HIT_5M and DOUBLED are lower bounds

graded.note: buy at the signal, sell when the row was graded (HIT_5M as a limit sell at the target, filled at min(peak, target) with the depth recorded at the peak sample; RUGGED at the depth seen at rug detection; otherwise at the horizon); $100 per signal, net of pool fees and impact on both legs at the liquidity that existed at each; 0 of a 50-signal minimum: counts only, no claim of edge

hold.note: buy at the signal, sell at the 72 h horizon mark whatever happened in between (the replicable rule; a pool classified rugged is -100 under this rule); $100 per signal, net of pool fees and impact on both legs at the liquidity that existed at each; 0 of a 50-signal minimum: counts only, no claim of edge

peak.note: sell at the sampled peak (a ceiling, not an achievable exit; a rug after the peak does not lower it); $100 per signal, net of pool fees and impact on both legs, the exit priced at the liquidity recorded at the peak, or the entry pool's depth for rows older than that recording (the ceiling is understated when depth grew with price); 0 of a 50-signal minimum: counts only, no claim of edge

expectancy.basis: graded first-ENTER rows by rule version: none (unversioned rows predate the rule book and are pooled with the current version until a replay re-labels them). first ENTER signal per coin, graded rows only; entry at the signal's liquidity; pool fees and impact on both legs. graded: HIT_5M rows as a limit sell at the target, filled at min(peak, target) with the depth recorded at the peak sample (not a hold to the horizon); other rows at the liquidity the grader saw when it closed them (RUGGED at rug detection). hold: exit at the 72 h horizon mark, recorded for every row detected since 2026-10-20 within a day of its horizon (older or unpriced rows are skipped); a pool classified rugged is -100 under hold only; graded prices it at the rug-detection depth and peak keeps the pre-rug peak as a ceiling. peak: the sampled peak at its own recorded liquidity, or the entry depth for rows older than the recording. Rows the horizon pass could not price (pair gone from the feeds) are counted and shown; above a 20% share the validation label is INSUFFICIENT DATA. Market-cap multiples stand in for price multiples, which overstates the move when supply grew
